title: The Will of the Tianji Record
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was caught in a dilemma, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly burned hot, and the familiar voice of the residual soul guardian Mo Xiansheng rang out once more—yet carrying an unprecedented urgency.

text.content:
The darkness of the tomb passage seemed to take on substance, like an invisible tide swallowing Chen Ji whole. Cold sensations pressed in from all directions, yet strangely, there was no feeling of suffocation—as if the darkness itself was some kind of medium, carrying him deeper into the abyss.

Instinctively, Chen Ji tried to circulate spiritual energy for protection, but found it mired in his body like mud, flowing with great difficulty. Yet the Tianji Record Fragment on his chest suddenly burned hot, faintly emitting a pale golden glow that became the sole source of light in this absolute darkness.

dialogue.content:
"Successor, you have finally arrived."

The ethereal figure slowly coalesced in the depths of the tomb, its outline growing clearer—it was Chen Xuan's form, yet bearing a terrifying pressure. His eyes were not the ordinary black of mortals, but flowed with starlike brilliant golden light, as if containing within them the laws governing all creation.

text.content: Chen Ji halted his steps, his expression unchanged. He slowly raised his head, meeting those starry eyes, his voice calm to the point of coldness: "Chen Xuan, elder? No... you are not any possibility I foresaw." He narrowed his eyes. "The aura of the Tianji Record, yet not a mere residual soul. What exactly are you?"

dialogue.content: The ethereal figure's lips curved slightly upward, revealing a meaningful smile: "You are perceptive." His voice resonated like an ancient bell from distant ages. "Indeed, I am neither soul nor mortal flesh. When the Tianji Record was first created, it was granted independent will—and I am the embodiment of that will."

text.content: A great storm surged in Chen Ji's heart, yet his face remained unruffled. He glanced down at the glowing fragment on his chest, his voice low: "So over these ten thousand years, every choice the Tianji Record guided me to make... was your will? Including leading me here?" He paused. "If that is truly so, why not simply control me directly? Why go through all this trouble?"

dialogue.content: "Control?" The figure let out a light laugh, laughter carrying inexplicable complexity. "You think the Tianji Record is your shackle, yet you know not that the true shackle lies elsewhere." His form abruptly drew near, pressure bearing down like a collapsing mountain. "Do you know that ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan created me not to predict Heavenly Fate—but to break it!"

text.content: In that moment, Chen Ji finally felt a genuine tremor of uncertainty. Break Heavenly Fate? Those four words rang like thunderclaps in the silent tomb. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had once said—"The Tianji Record is not a tool for prophesying the future, but a key to rewriting fate." Could this be its true purpose?

Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to calm. His fingers curled slightly, nails digging deep into his palms—this was his habitual gesture when facing major decisions. After a moment, he raised his head once more, his gaze sharp as a blade: "Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan failed. Do you wish me to repeat his defeat?"

dialogue.content:
"Chen Xuan failed because of his excessive arrogance." The figure's voice suddenly dropped low, carrying a note of weariness that Chen Ji had never heard before. "He believed he could stand alone against the Heavenly Dao, not knowing that the Eyes of Heaven had long ago set an intricate trap. He lost because he fought alone."

He paused, those starry eyes fixing directly on Chen Ji: "But you are different. You have allies, have attachments, have... vulnerabilities."

text.content:
The word "vulnerabilities" struck Chen Ji's ears, and his gaze turned razor-sharp. He thought of his missing sister Chen Nian, the girl taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key." Could it be... does the main will of the Tianji Record know even this?

He slowly spoke, his voice cold as if tempered in ice: "How long have you been watching me?"

choice.prompt: Faced with this being claiming to be the will of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji must make a judgment—is it friend or foe?

choices.description: The Tianji Record has never actively harmed me; perhaps it truly is another path
choices.visible_reward: Gain Qualification for Tianji Record Core Inheritance
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, may fall into eternal ruin

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly nodded: "Very well. I am willing to listen to what you have to say." The moment the words fell, the fragment on his chest suddenly burst forth with unprecedented brilliant golden light, as if responding to his decision.

choices.description: Any being suddenly showing goodwill deserves wariness; first hear what he has to say

text.content: Chen Ji did not immediately respond, merely standing with hands behind his back, his gaze deep as an abyss. That ethereal figure seemed to sense something, and instead showed a hint of approval: "Cautious. This is the instinct of the wise."

choices.description: Use information only the Tianji Record could know to verify its identity
choices.visible_cost: Exhaust energy preparing for possible traps
choices.risk_hint: If the other party is genuine, it might leave a bad impression

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly spoke: "Since you claim to be the body of the Tianji Record, I ask you—what is written on the third page fragment?" This was a secret even Mo Xiansheng did not know.

The air in the tomb seemed to freeze. Chen Ji stared directly at those star-like eyes, waiting for the other party to reveal a flaw or prove their identity. After a moment, the phantom suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the endless darkness: "'Heavenly secrets can be measured, fate is ever-changing, only by keeping the heart unchanged can one see the true chapter'—am I correct?"

Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. This sentence, he had never told anyone, not even Mo Xiansheng. The text on the third page of the fragment was obscure and difficult to understand—he had always thought it was just meaningless remnants of ancient classics...

"You are indeed the Tianji Record." He spoke slowly, his voice carrying a complex undertone, "But that doesn't mean I will fully trust you. Speak then, what do you want me to do?"

dialogue.content:
"Complete Chen Xuan's unfinished work." The voice no longer carried its previous playfulness, becoming solemn and dignified. "The Eye of Heavenly Will is not invincible. Ten thousand years ago, Chen Xuan found its weakness, only he didn't have time to implement it. Your second trial is about to begin—I can tell you a shortcut, but the price is..."

Its gaze fell upon Chen Ji's chest. "You must make a choice now: continue viewing the Tianji Record as a shackle, struggling alone; or accept its true inheritance, merging with me as one?"

text.content:
Chen Ji's heart suddenly raced. "Merging as one"—what did these four words mean? Losing oneself? Or gaining unprecedented power? Countless thoughts flashed through his mind—Su Qingyao's reminder, Ye Qing's warning, Mo Xiansheng's meaningful words...

At this moment, a faint fluctuation suddenly emerged from the depths of his divine sense—the aura of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the fragment, weak and urgent, as if transmitting some kind of warning.

choice.prompt: The will of the Tianji Record presented a major choice, concerning his future path—

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is the key to rewriting fate, there's no reason to refuse
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the core technique on the second page of the complete Tianji Record

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly extending his right hand, pressing it against the fragment glowing with golden light on his chest. In an instant, a warm and vast power surged from the fragment, pouring into his meridians like countless rivers returning to the sea. Agonizing pain and transformation struck simultaneously—he couldn't help but let out a muffled groan.

choices.description: Merging is too risky, guard the heart first

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his right hand, stepping back. A flash of... loss? Or approval? appeared in the phantom's eyes. "As you wish. Holding fast to one's heart is also a path. Only... you will face the dangers of the second trial alone."

choices.description: Propose one's own conditions to ensure not losing the initiative
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the inheritance under guaranteed conditions
choices.risk_hint: The other party may not accept the conditions

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, a faint smile curling at the corner of his lips: 'I can accept the inheritance, but I have one condition—after the fusion, my consciousness must maintain absolute dominance. If you agree, I will cooperate with you; if not...' He paused, 'I would rather perish in the second trial than become anyone's puppet.'

The depths of the tomb fell into deathly silence. Those star-like eyes gazed at Chen Ji, as if trying to see through all his secrets and pretenses. After a long while, the phantom let out a soft sigh, its voice carrying a hint of... satisfaction?

'Good.' The voice was calm and resolute, 'I agree to your conditions. The dominance of consciousness will always belong to you—this is the fundamental law of my existence, never broken by anyone.'

The moment the words fell, Chen Ji sensed an unprecedented surge of power gushing from the void, like a flood filling a parched riverbed. The fragment at his chest trembled violently, golden light growing ever more intense, until it actually drifted from his chest, suspended between them—one person and one spirit.

Within the golden radiance, the fragment slowly unfurled, revealing ancient characters Chen Ji had never before witnessed.

dialogue.content:
'This represents the core inheritance of the Tianji Record's second page.' The voice resonated near Chen Ji, solemn and sacred, 'Chen Xuan once exhausted his entire life's essence attempting to use the Tianji Record as a conduit to breach the channel to the fundamental source of heaven's way. Over ten thousand years, countless seers have emerged and perished—yet you alone have progressed to this juncture.'

Golden light abruptly gathered, transforming into a luminous stream that penetrated Chen Ji's brow center. A vast tide of information surged through his mental sea, encompassing comprehensive intelligence about the second trial and an unprecedented shortcut.

text.content:
Chen Ji closed his eyes, permitting the information to churn within his mental sea. After a moment, he reopened his eyes, a glint of comprehension flickering in his gaze. The true crux of the second trial lay in...

At this instant, the ground beneath his feet suddenly began to tremble violently. A thunderous roar echoed from the tomb's depths, as if some enormous being was awakening.

'Time is running out.' The voice turned urgent, 'The second trial has commenced—follow the route I just provided, and you will reach the core faster than I anticipated.'

Chen Ji raised his head toward the dissipating phantom, speaking up abruptly: 'Wait. You mentioned Chen Xuan sought the weakness of the Heavenly Eye—that weakness, what is it exactly?' He had to know, even just a fragment.

The phantom's outline had faded to near invisibility, leaving only a few ethereal words drifting through the tomb's depths: 'The Heavenly Eye... is not unshakeable. Its power stems from the reverence all beings hold for destiny, and the Tianji Record's true purpose is to make this reverence... crumble entirely.'

As the words faded, the tomb's trembling grew even more violent. Chen Ji had no time to dwell on the information he had just received—his figure flashed, racing along the path indicated by the Tianji Record.

The moment his silhouette vanished, a faint spiritual fluctuation emerged from the fragment hidden in his embrace. It was Mo Xiansheng's voice, urgent and tense: 'Young master, there is a trap in the second trial, one this old servant must warn you about...'

In the midst of the rumbling, Chen Ji's figure had already disappeared into the depths of darkness, and his second trial was officially beginning.
